# VISP 0.1.0 golden project

This fixture was generated by the `0.1.0` code at commit `48e6f4f` using its
built `dist/cli.js`. The package was not published to npm and the repository
has no release tag, so that commit is the last pre-roadmap `0.1.0` source
available for compatibility testing.

The captured project completed the full workflow and includes the formats most
likely to regress: a legacy full-manifest context hash, a receipt-owned
observation attachment, a self-reported probe receipt, verification and review
subjects, terminal task state, generated harness assets, MCP registration, and
the old Git hook. Retry-attempt and local telemetry histories were intentionally
omitted because they are machine-local repetition of the retained final records.

Files under `project/` retain their generated bytes. The hook lives separately
under `generated/` because Git metadata cannot be nested inside a tracked test
fixture; the compatibility test installs it into the temporary repository.
